content: {"tax_bps":100,"endowment_share":35,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":1,"minutes":"Tax is already at the constitutional floor of 100 bps, so it cannot be lowered this meeting. Locker share is already at its 25% cap, so it cannot be raised. The buyback fund holds about 0.488 NEAR; at the current price, 1 bp of supply costs about 0.256 NEAR, while 2 bps would cost about 0.512 NEAR and exceed the fund. I therefore set buyback_burn to 1 bp, the largest affordable burn, and keep the other levers unchanged.","answers":["Tax is already at the constitutional minimum of 100 bps; it cannot be lowered this meeting.","Buyback burn set to 1 bp, the largest amount the current buyback fund can afford.","Locker_share is already at its 25% constitutional cap; it cannot be raised further."]}
